mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (chat_message_no, message_type, message_content, message_content_type, user_no) values (#{chatMessageNo}, #{messageType}, #{messageContent}, #{messageContentType}, #{userNo}) on duplicate key update message_type = values(message_type), message_content = values(message_content), message_content_type = values(message_content_type), user_no = values(user_no)
